marketMtAppointmentWhyUsP1: At StrongBody, we're making health care easy.
marketMtAppointmentWhyUsP2: You can search, compare, discuss and book your care all in one place.
marketMtAppointmentWhyUsP3: We connect you with verified providers worldwide, saving you time and energy along the way — and it is all free, with no hidden fees.
marketMtAppointmentWhyUsP4: So what are you waiting for?
marketMtCoordinatorsIntro: Local experts who know the hospitals, retreats, prices and visas — each card shows who they represent. Start free; the planning fee is credited when you book.
marketMtDestinationsSubtitle: Each destination has its own local coordinator.
marketMtDetailBeforeBookDesc: Upload these in your patient portal to speed up your quote — and your visa letter, if you need one.
marketMtDetailCrossSellDesc: {name} can answer questions about this package before you book — free to chat.
marketMtDetailCrossSellTitle: Not sure this is the right package?
marketMtDetailNoPayment: No payment until your plan is confirmed.
marketMtDetailPriceNote: Final price follows the provider's evaluation — you approve the fixed quote before anything is charged.
marketMtFaqItemsCancelA: Each package states its cancellation window up front. Because payment is only collected after your plan is confirmed — and held by StrongBody until you arrive — cancelling inside the window is free, and disputes are raised with us before any money moves to the facility.
marketMtFaqItemsCancelQ: What happens if I need to cancel or my trip changes?
marketMtFaqItemsCoordinatorsA: Vetted, identity-checked experts based in the destination who arrange medical trips for a living. Some are independent and advise across every facility; others officially represent one hospital — the affiliation is always shown on their card, so you know whose advice you're getting. The intro call is free; the planning session (facility shortlist, fixed quotes, visa checklist, itinerary) is priced per destination — from $15 — and credited toward your booking.
marketMtFaqItemsCoordinatorsQ: Who are the local care coordinators?
marketMtFaqItemsLanguageA: Before the trip, MultiMe AI translates your chat and video consults live in 100+ languages. On site, packages state whether a dedicated medical translator accompanies you — most international departments include one for consultations, consent forms and results read-outs.
marketMtFaqItemsLanguageQ: What if I don't speak the local language?
marketMtFaqItemsPriceA: Listed prices are "from" estimates in USD covering the stated inclusions. After your free consult and any pre-checks, the facility sends a fixed quote — the final price can change only with the doctor’s evaluation, and nothing is charged until you approve the confirmed plan.
marketMtFaqItemsPriceQ: Is the listed price what I'll actually pay?
marketMtFaqItemsVerificationA: Every facility passes identity checks plus verification of its operating licence with the Ministry of Health of its country. International accreditations shown on a listing — JCI, ISO 9001, ISQua — are checked against the issuing body’s registry, and the profile names that registry.
marketMtFaqItemsVerificationQ: How are hospitals and clinics verified?
marketMtFaqItemsVisaA: It depends on your passport and destination. Where a visa is needed, the facility issues a medical visa invitation letter as part of your package — you’ll see a "Visa letter" tag on the listing. You apply at the embassy yourself; consular fees aren’t included. Upload your passport data page and recent medical history in the patient portal to speed the letter up.
marketMtFaqItemsVisaQ: Do I need a medical visa, and who arranges it?
